keyFacts: Every YouTube video has thumbnails stored at predictable addresses on i.ytimg.com — the tool simply builds those addresses from the video ID.
Five sizes are published: maxresdefault (1280x720), sddefault (640x480), hqdefault (480x360), mqdefault (320x180) and default (120x90).
The video ID is the 11-character code in a YouTube link, for example the part after v= in a watch URL.
maxresdefault is only published when the uploaded video is at least 720p — older or low-resolution uploads may lack it.
This tool never downloads or touches the video itself — only its thumbnail image.
